hosted.title: Load hosted CSS and images in HTML Viewer
hosted.context: The hosted example from the guide is already in HTML Viewer. Turn on Allow external resources to load its stylesheet and woodland photo from docs.phcode.dev. Scripts stay off; this setting does not open neighboring files on your computer.
hosted.label: Load hosted CSS and images in HTML Viewer: a silent recording of the real controls and result

scripts.title: Test inline JavaScript in HTML Viewer
scripts.context: The guide’s self-contained HTML example and Test button are already in the source. Click with scripts off, enable Allow external resources and Run scripts, then click again to see Clicked. This demonstrates inline code, not an external script file.
scripts.label: Test inline JavaScript in HTML Viewer: a silent recording of the real controls and result
